title: Self-induced discoloration of the face with red exogenous pigment detected by dermoscopy: a novel type of dermatitis artefacta in the COVID-19 era
details: V Piccolo, T Russo, C Mazzatenta, G Argenziano… - Dermatology Reports, 2025
abstract: Dear Editor, Dermatitis artefacta (DA) is a condition on the border of psychiatry and dermatology, characterized by patients intentionally causing skin lesions to pretend that they are ill. DA is a very challenging entity to diagnose, as it can mimic many …
